name: Pennsylvania

period.description: Your income is compared over a six-month period, and your medical costs must cover the extra income for that period.

submission.description: Give proof of your medical bills to your County Assistance Office. For unpaid bills, show that the provider has not written them off and you still owe them.

notes: Health insurance premiums are counted through the spend-down.
Only the part of a bill needed to qualify is used; the rest can count later within the allowed time.
Unpaid bills from the retroactive months can count if you still owe them. A payment plan is not required.
